subject: Pilot access playbook and sprint owners — DataWave trial
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <mchen@datawave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access playbook and sprint owners — DataWave trial

Hi Maya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your eval into a 4‑week sprint window. Please read and confirm anything I missed.

High level success criteria (from our call):
- Integrations: Redwood inference API can be called from DataWave's ingestion pipeline with <= 200ms token latency for 512-token evals.
- Safety & compliance: No persistent logging of PII in the sandbox, audit logs available for sample requests.
- Quality: Fewer than 10% regression on the benchmark prompt set you shared (initial baseline run).
- Ops: Team can manage keys and SSO access with our SAML integration.

Requested from your side to start provisioning:
1) SAML issuer / metadata URL for DataWave Okta (or an invite list for SSO).
2) IP allowlist ranges for your egress (we'll add to the sandbox firewall).
3) 2–3 pilot users (emails) for initial canary and 8–10 broader users later.

Redwood asks / plan:
- We’ll provision a private sandbox project, create scoped API keys, and enable prefix caching and tracing for the trial.
- Timeline: keys + SSO invites by Mon 2027-04-04, baseline run and smoke tests by 2027-04-08, full eval sprint 4 weeks after smoke test.
- Owners: Rishi (sales/PM), Marissa (ops provisioning), Grace (solutions + eval support).

Attachments: redwood_pilot_moa.pdf (MOA + basic SOW stub).

If that looks right, reply with SSO metadata and the IP ranges and we’ll kick off provisioning.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Chen <mchen@datawave.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Park <liam.park@datawave.ai>, DataWave IT <it@datawave.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access playbook and sprint owners — DataWave trial

Thanks Rishi, this is great — confirming from our side. Apologies for the quick reply window, pulled this together with Liam.

Confirm success criteria: all good. One note on latency: our production egress is fast, but for the trial we expect traffic from a single region (us-west). If you can surface regional routing we’ll validate latency there first.

SSO / IP details:
- SAML metadata URL: https://okta.datawave.ai/app/saml/metadata.xml
- Admin contact for invites: liam.park@datawave.ai
- Pilot user list (canary): maya.chen@datawave.ai, liam.park@datawave.ai
- Full pilot roster (to follow in separate email): expected 8 users by 2027-04-06.
- IP egress ranges (CIDR): 54.210.0.0/16, 3.236.48.0/20 (please add these to the sandbox allowlist).

Other asks:
- We’d like an API key scoped to inference.generate + embedding.create only (no admin).
- Default token TTL: 24 hours for pilot keys.
- Can you enable request-level trace IDs so our telemetry maps requests back to sessions?

Attached: DataWave_network-overview.pdf (network diagram) — forwarded to your ops contact as well.

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Provision DataWave sandbox + scoped keys (DW-3421)

Marissa — looping you in to kick the provisioning work. Summary below and action items with deadlines. Maya confirmed SAML metadata and IP ranges (see her reply).

What we need from Ops (owner: Marissa):
- Create a private sandbox project for DataWave, region us-west.
- Apply IP allowlist: 54.210.0.0/16, 3.236.48.0/20.
- Create two scoped API keys:
  * DW-pilot-canary (scopes: inference.generate, embedding.create) — TTL 24h, usage limit 200 req/min
  * DW-pilot-bulk (same scopes) — TTL 24h, later rotate to longer TTL if approved
- Enable request tracing and prefix/KV caching features for the project.
- Send SSO invite instructions for Okta and verify SAML metadata import (owner: Marissa).

Deadline: please have keys and initial sandbox ready by Mon 2027-04-04 EOD PST. We’ll do a smoke test Tue morning.

References: HubSpot deal link — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DW-3421
Attachments: sample-config.json (example client config that DataWave can use).

Thanks for jumping on this — happy to hop on a quick 15m if there are any questions.

—
Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: Provision DataWave sandbox + scoped keys (DW-3421)

All set — provisioning done and keys delivered below.

What I completed:
- Private sandbox created: project id rw-dw-dw3421-sandbox (region: us-west).
- IP allowlist applied: 54.210.0.0/16, 3.236.48.0/20.
- Keys created (scoped, TTL 24h):
  * DW-pilot-canary — key id: key_dw_canary_8f7a (scoped: inference.generate, embedding.create)
  * DW-pilot-bulk — key id: key_dw_bulk_3c2b
  (Note: keys have been sent to liam.park@datawave.ai via secure link — he must accept to retrieve.)
- Request tracing enabled and prefix/KV cache set to conservative mode for trial.

Attachments: sample-config.json (attached) — contains curl examples and header usage for the scoped key.

Next steps / notes:
- SAML import: I attempted to import the URL you provided; please confirm Okta admin accepted the redirect. If not, send the raw metadata XML.
- If DataWave needs longer TTLs or wildcard scopes during the eval, we’ll do a controlled rotation request (create a Jira ticket linking to DW-3421).
- Owner for smoke test: Grace will run the initial baseline today at 11:00 AM PST and report latency and any token errors.

If anyone needs the keys resent to a different email, let me know.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
